correctness.rationale: Every definition, integer range and intrinsic metric are explicit. The probability design on all ab+C(b,2) bases has covariance with three independently derived positive eigenvalues. Its strictly concave log determinant has one interior optimum. A covariance-derivative identity equates both orbit gauges, while the trace identity forces each to equal d. Averaging the quadratic gauge for any competing ellipsoid and applying matrix AM-GM gives determinant minimality and equality-based uniqueness. The decoded standalone checker confirms 361 parameter identities and 49 complete covariance and contact enumerations; these are corroboration, not infinite proof.

value.rationale: This is an intrinsically motivated geometric invariant—the least-volume outer ellipsoid—of a natural connected elementary split matroid base polytope, not an arbitrary parameter slice. Determining a unique optimal two-orbit mass, all contact vertices, three exact semiaxis eigenspaces and intrinsic volume for all dimensions is a complete exact classification that cannot be inferred from the known face enumeration, inball or normal-cone spectrum. The result is potentially useful as an analytic prototype for higher-complexity matroid outer ellipsoids; no downstream theorem is presumed.
